ev.q: Door Kickers is a real-time tactics video game
combines elements of strategy games and tactical shooters
the player is directed to plan the individual movements and actions of each trooper
As the team completes missions they will level up, both as a team and individually
can be used in a skill tree to improve their overall proficiency
Stars earned from completing missions can be spent on new weapons and equipment
Stealth troopers, who will hold fire as long as they are undetected
